summary: The proof is mathematically complete. Affine-unimodular invariance is handled correctly; restriction of an ambient halfspace to a fiber gives the required pointwise depth domination; the accepted box and one-dimensional inequalities apply with all stated boundary cases; Holder's inequality yields the exact M-dependent factors; and the finite product-support constructions correctly establish the claimed r=1 and r=0 infimal sharpness coefficients, including k=0 and singleton cases.
